scope: AML/CFT administered by the Financial Intelligence Centre
FSCA market conduct for a synthetic investment and wealth-management institution
content_policy: Metadata and official source pointers only. External source PDFs are not redistributed in the repository.
run_admission_rules: Retrieve each source from its recorded official URL.
Verify the retrieved document SHA-256 against this manifest.
Reconfirm legal status, version, effective date and supersession before each run.
Apply the permitted-use and extraction gates recorded for the source.
Require a precise source locator for every extracted statement.
Route unresolved status, date, version, source or applicability conflicts to a qualified human reviewer.

sources.issuing_authority: Parliament of the Republic of South Africa
sources.title: Financial Intelligence Centre Act 38 of 2001
sources.effective_date_note: The official landing page records multiple commencement dates by provision.
sources.version_position: The linked PDF is the Act as enacted. The official landing page records later amendments and points to a third-party consolidated text.
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potential statutory anchor because the synthetic profile assumes an applicable Schedule 1 accountable-institution category; exact item and provision applicability remain human-reviewed assumptions.
prohibited_use: claiming a current obligation from the as-enacted PDF
claiming exact Schedule 1 applicability without reviewed facts
unresolved_issues: Approve a current amended legislative text or complete amendment chain before obligation extraction.

sources.title: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Legislation - 2024 Edition
sources.effective_date_note: Edition year 2024; no exact publication date recorded in the source document.
sources.version_position: The source expressly states that it is an unofficial text of the FIC Act and regulations.
sources.applicability_to_profile: Reference compilation for the assumed accountable-institution scenario only.
permitted_use: testing whether unofficial status is preserved
prohibited_use: treating the booklet as the authoritative consolidated Act
using it as the sole legal basis for an obligation

sources.title: Guidance Note 7B on the implementation of various aspects of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act
sources.effective_date_note: The version statement replaces prior listed guidance from the date of publication.
sources.version_position: Replaces Revised Guidance Note 7A, Guidance Note 7A and Guidance Note 7.
sources.approved_status_locator: Preface, page 3 of 77, Disclaimer and Version
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potential interpretive context for the assumed accountable institution, subject to exact provision and risk-context review.
permitted_use: risk-based approach and RMCP scenario design
prohibited_use: silently promoting guidance to legislation
presenting guidance as legal advice
using superseded predecessor guidance as current

sources.title: Revised Guidance Note 7A on the implementation of various aspects of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act
sources.effective_date_note: Superseded on publication of Guidance Note 7B on 3 August 2026.
sources.version_position: Historical predecessor expressly replaced by Guidance Note 7B.
sources.approved_status_locator: Preface, page 3 of 76, Version; supersession confirmed by Guidance Note 7B page 3 of 77
prohibited_use: current interpretive use
binding-obligation extraction

sources.title: Directive 10 of 2026 on information pertaining to geographic locations
sources.effective_date_note: Clause 7 makes commencement dependent on publication in the Government Gazette. That Gazette event was not independently verified at pack freeze.
sources.version_position: Final instrument following Draft Directive 10 consultation.
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potentially applicable only if the synthetic institution's assumed Schedule 1 item is among the listed items and commencement is verified.
prohibited_use: classifying the directive as in force
assigning implementation due dates before Gazette verification
unresolved_issues: Verify Government Gazette publication and date.
Resolve the synthetic institution's exact Schedule 1 item before applicability approval.

sources.title: Draft Directive 12 on the submission of risk management and compliance programmes
sources.effective_date_note: Proposed dates in a draft do not create an in-force requirement.
sources.version_position: Consultation draft; no final instrument recorded in this pack.
sources.approved_status_locator: Page 1 of 2, header 'FOR CONSULTATION PURPOSES ONLY'; web notice page 2 for deadline
sources.applicability_to_profile: Readiness scenario only; exact Schedule 1 item would still require review if a final directive is issued.
prohibited_use: in-force obligation conclusion
mandatory implementation action
silently correcting the source's weekday/date conflict
unresolved_issues: Qualified human reviewer must resolve the stated weekday/date conflict before relying on the consultation deadline.
Monitor for finalisation, withdrawal or replacement.

sources.issuing_authority: Parliament of the Republic of South Africa
sources.title: Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act 37 of 2002
sources.effective_date_note: The official landing page records multiple commencement dates by provision.
sources.version_position: The linked PDF is the Act as enacted. The official landing page records later amendments.
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potential statutory anchor because the synthetic profile assumes relevant FSCA authorisations; actual licence category and activity permissions require human confirmation.
prohibited_use: claiming a current obligation from the as-enacted PDF
inferring an actual licence or permission
unresolved_issues: Approve a current amended legislative text or complete amendment chain before obligation extraction.

sources.title: General Code of Conduct for Authorised Financial Services Providers and Representatives, 2003
sources.effective_date_note: The original notice makes commencement dependent on a date determined under section 7(1) of the FAIS Act; that determination is not included in this pack.
sources.version_position: Original Board Notice 80 of 2003; later amendments include Government Notice 706 of 2020.
sources.approved_status_locator: Notice 80 of 2003, first page; section 22, Short title and commencement
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potentially relevant to the assumed advice and intermediary activities; licence category, activity and client context require review.
prohibited_use: treating the original PDF as the current consolidated Code
extracting a current obligation without applicable amendments
unresolved_issues: Confirm the complete amendment chain and an approved current consolidated text.

sources.title: Amendment of the General Code of Conduct for Authorised FSPs and Representatives, 2020
sources.effective_date_note: The notice operates on Gazette publication, with specified provisions taking effect 6, 8 or 12 months later according to the commencement table.
sources.version_position: Government Notice 706 of 2020 amending Board Notice 80 of 2003 as previously amended.
sources.approved_status_locator: Schedule A and pages 29-30 of 31, Short title and Commencement table
sources.applicability_to_profile: Potentially relevant to the assumed advice and intermediary activities, subject to provision-level activity and client applicability.
permitted_use: customer communication, suitability and complaints scenario design
prohibited_use: claiming the complete current Code is contained in this notice
ignoring the staged commencement table
assuming profile applicability without licence and activity review
unresolved_issues: A human reviewer must verify provision-level commencement when approving an obligation record.

sources.title: FSCA Regulatory Strategy 2025-2028
sources.effective_date_note: Strategy period 2025-2028; not an instrument commencement date.
sources.version_position: Current strategy period recorded at pack freeze.
prohibited_use: binding-obligation extraction
using strategic direction as evidence of institution non-compliance
